Smooth middle, credit to the ramp team
It was a good run
Gentle Check-ins for Every Paw

At the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways, the week stayed steady and calm, with careful records, clear handoffs, and patient support for each traveler and pet. The team kept safety first without rushing anyone, and supervisors remained ready to listen whenever a passenger felt unsure. Advice stayed brief, kind, and practical, which helped keep each step easy to follow.

We also saw good coordination with baggage and cabin staff, so pets moved through the day with less stress and more comfort. Small details made the difference, from confirming crate fit to checking that documents were in order and that owners felt settled before departure. The desk is pleased to report that routine work held firm, service stayed warm, and the next departures should continue in the same steady way.
